data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as one of your **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** units is about to make a [Consolidation move](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move).

**Target:** That same **CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER** unit.

**Effect:** Whenever the unit makes a Consolidation move, its models can move an extra 3" if the unit is able to finish that move in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of an enemy unit, for the rest of the phase.
